title: auth_resolve_v1 has failed 2286 times in the last 24h under a single failure class (unclassified), and NO OPEN GAP NAMES
description: auth_resolve_v1 has failed 2286 times in the last 24h under a single failure class (unclassified), and NO OPEN GAP NAMES IT. The count is not the defect — the defect is that the system observed the same fact 2286 times and changed nothing: it did not stop selecting the activity, did not open a gap against the cause, and did not try a different route. The class is UNCLASSIFIED, which compounds it: with no recorded failure mode these take the strict default penalty, so an activity is being blamed 2286 times for a cause nobody has named. If the cause is environmental, that blame is false and is paid for twice — once in the wrong penalty and again in a posterior decay aggressive enough to forget it, which discards real evidence too. First action is to classify the failure, not to suppress the count: identical failures should not be possible, and where they occur they remain independent samples.
